name: SUPPLY CONVOY AMBUSH
situation_report: Intelligence reports an enemy supply convoy moving along the desert road. This is an opportunity to strike a critical blow against enemy logistics. Your forces have positioned for an ambush. Destroy or capture the convoy trucks before they escape.
tactical_context: The ambusher must strike fast and hard before escorts can react. The convoy must keep moving - stopping means destruction. Classic desert warfare: fast raids on vulnerable supply lines.

terrain_features.name: Desert Road/Track
terrain_features.description: Main supply route for the convoy
terrain_features.special_rules: Fast movement for vehicles. Convoy must stay on road.

terrain_features.name: Mud-Brick Village
terrain_features.description: Small North African village with adobe houses.
terrain_features.special_rules: Buildings provide hard cover. Narrow streets are difficult terrain for vehicles.

terrain_features.name: Salt Flat (Sabkha)
terrain_features.description: Dried salt lake bed. Treacherous for vehicles.
terrain_features.special_rules: Looks flat but is dangerous terrain for vehicles (risk of breakthrough). Infantry move normally.

terrain_features.name: Rocky Desert
terrain_features.description: Desert floor scattered with rocks and stones.
terrain_features.special_rules: Vehicles treat as difficult terrain. Infantry move normally.

terrain_features.name: Fortified Position
terrain_features.description: Prepared defensive position with trenches and dugouts.
terrain_features.special_rules: Infantry gain hard cover with +1 to cover saves. Difficult terrain for vehicles.

terrain_notes: Open terrain with limited cover near the road

effects: All aircraft grounded (Air Attack counters automatically fail)
All off-road terrain counts as difficult

victory_conditions:
**Attacker Victory**: Destroy or capture 2+ convoy trucks before they escape.

**Defender Victory**: Get 2+ trucks off East edge OR destroy ambush force.

**Draw**: Equal trucks destroyed/escaped, or convoy halted.
deployment_steps: Place road running E-W across table
Defender places 3-4 convoy trucks on road at West edge
Defender deploys escort forces within 6" of convoy
Attacker places hidden deployment markers (reveal when acting)
Convoy begins moving East on turn 1
Ambush is sprung when attacker reveals or defender spots them

deployment_zones.location: Hidden deployment within 18" of road (excluding defender zone)
special_rules: Deploy hidden (reveal when moving or firing)
May deploy after seeing convoy positions

deployment_zones.location: West table edge moving East along road
special_rules: Convoy trucks must be on road
Convoy moves first turn toward East edge

objectives.spacing_rules: Trucks start on road in defender's deployment zone
objectives.placed_by: Defender places convoy trucks on road

special_rules: **Convoy Movement**: Trucks move 12" per turn along road toward East edge
**Hidden Deployment**: Attacker deploys hidden, reveals when moving/firing
**Surprise**: First turn of ambush, attacker gets +1 to hit
**Truck Vulnerability**: Convoy trucks have Armor 0, destroyed on any penetrating hit
**Escape**: Trucks that exit East edge are saved (count as objectives held)
**Escort**: Defender must keep escorts within 12" of convoy or trucks stop
